summary: Frontend-only verification of security hardening changes (CSP meta tag + role-based Reports gating). All 5 test cases PASSED. CSP does not break the SPA (no CSP-related console errors, no page errors). clinic_admin sees 'Reportes' in sidebar and can view /dashboard/reportes with reports-page rendered and all 3 tabs (Resumen ejecutivo, Ingresos, Estado de resultados) present. doctor and receptionist do NOT see 'Reportes' in sidebar, and direct navigation to /dashboard/reportes shows reports-no-access guard with restricted-access message. Regression check on Pacientes and Agenda navigation for clinic_admin passed. No forced password reset for any of the 3 accounts.
